render: painterly digital illustration with the restraint of a museum diorama
material: matte surfaces, visible texture on wood, rope and cloth, no plastic sheen
processing: gentle contrast curve, slightly lifted blacks, no halos or oversharpening

optics.focal: 35mm equivalent at eye level unless the shot asks otherwise
optics.depth: moderate depth of field, background readable but soft

light.character: motivated light from the period's own sources
light.direction: one dominant side light, soft fill from the environment

palette.rule: earthy base with one restrained accent per frame

grain: fine even film grain across the frame
composition: one clear subject on the thirds, horizon never through the middle
